processor.model: GitHub-hosted standard runner vCPU (fleet does not pin one model)

benchmark.configuration: One fresh packaged-CLI process per measured run over the unchanged manifest-bound fixture, driven through a rendered browser page; the automatic initial Repository scan settles outside timing; exactly one explicit Repository rescan is dispatched by activating the 'Rescan repository' control and both timers start at that dispatch; the one-second timer stops at the first visibly rendered, live-region-exposed status correlated to that request (the page renders per-request progress only under the admitted scanRequestId), and the ten-second timer stops when the complete 500-row inventory from that request's committed generation is rendered with its filter controls operable. Then, in that same process on that same committed generation: the standardized filter interaction types the path query 'perf-skill-250' into the 'Path contains' field, measured inside the page from input dispatch until the one matching row is visibly rendered; the standardized item-selection interaction activates the first skill row's detail link, measured inside the page from click dispatch until the detail route's own heading or loading state is visibly rendered as the selection feedback.
benchmark.notes: No SC-002 measurement set is published under this profile ID: this profile binds the fixture manifest for the T183 non-gating smoke pass, and a hosted-runner fleet cannot freeze the exact processor model or image revision the spec requires of a measurement profile. T918 selects the frozen measurement host and mints the measurement profile from that host's exact values; any profile-field change mints a new, non-comparable profile.
